rows.label: Concept
rows.text: Light arrives as photons (E = hf): one photon ejects one electron iff hf exceeds the work function φ₀ — intensity raises numbers, never electron energy; frequency decides everything, with instant emission and a threshold wavelength. De Broglie mirrors it: matter carries wavelength λ = h/p. Bohr's quantised orbits explain hydrogen's lines; mass defect (×c²) binds nuclei with fission/fusion paying toward iron. Doped semiconductors (p-n, diode, transistor) plus logic gates close the unit in electronics.

rows.label: Formula
rows.text: Einstein: hf = φ₀ + K_max · K_max = eV₀ (stopping potential) · threshold: f₀ = φ₀/h  ·  de Broglie: λ = h/mv  ·  Bohr: Eₙ = −13.6/n² eV, mvr = nh/2π  ·  B.E. = Δm·c² ·  gates: AND(·) OR(+) NOT(¯), NAND/NOR universal

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: Photoemission needs f > f₀ (any intensity); V₀ measures K_max only with sharp collector geometry. De Broglie matters measurably for electrons, not cricket balls. Bohr works for single-electron species. Diode/transistor behaviour assumes proper biasing; gates assume ideal 0/1 levels.

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: Doubling intensity doubles photocurrent, not electron energy — the wave-theory killer. Davisson–Germer diffracted electrons (matter waves confirmed). Hydrogen lines: Lyman (UV), Balmer (visible), Paschen (IR) from ΔE jumps. NAND/NOR build every other gate (universal). Zener regulates voltage in reverse breakdown.

rows.label: Solved
rows.text: Stopping-potential reading: K_max = eV₀ plugs straight into hf = φ₀ + eV₀ — vary f, plot V₀ vs f: slope = h/e (Planck's constant measured!), intercept = −φ₀/e. Two points determine both constants; threshold frequency is the x-intercept.

rows.label: Limitation
rows.text: Photon picture alone cannot explain interference (wave–particle duality is irreducible). Bohr fails multi-electron atoms and fine structure. Logic gates idealise away noise margins, delays and fan-out. E = mc² prices conversion, not reaction rates.

rows.label: Derivation
rows.text: Energy ledger per photon: incoming hf splits into escape cost φ₀ plus leftover kinetic — conservation with quantisation assumed, yielding straight-line V₀–f graphs that Millikan verified. Bohr: centripetal + mvr = nh/2π → rₙ, Eₙ = −13.6/n² eV; differences ΔE = hν give every spectral series.

rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: 'Intensity vs frequency' questions: intensity→number, frequency→energy — always. Threshold: f₀ = φ₀/h, λ₀ = hc/φ₀. Hydrogen lines: 1/λ = R(1/n₁² − 1/n₂²). Gates: write truth tables (NAND = AND+NOT) rather than memorising.
